account:
Today I have heard a few things that might suggest preparations for a gathering, but nothing is confirmed. Townsfolk 02 reportedly noticed lights or decorations at the bakery. When the neighbour and I asked the baker, the baker denied arranging decorations or a celebration and said morning baking could explain the lights. The baker also asked whether any upcoming gatherings would need extra bread. Later, Townsfolk 08 and 28 both told me the innkeeper had been carrying a sack of bread at market. That could simply be supplies for the inn; I have no evidence linking it to the bakery report. I heard distant shouting but could not make out the words, so it tells me nothing definite.

The neighbour personally confirmed our usual three o'clock tea at the dockside cottage, (16,105). My secretary spent time trying to verify that invitation without success, but I have now clearly explained that the neighbour confirmed it directly. The secretary reported no specific accounts needing attention during our accounts appointment. I have just reached the cottage, shortly after three, and the neighbour is waiting nearby.

I still feel there may be something happening without my knowledge, perhaps a gathering involving extra bread, but that is only a suspicion. The baker denies knowing of a celebration, and the neighbour said they knew of no larger gathering. Tea is an opportunity to listen and ask about local news, rather than assume anyone is hiding something.
